name: pending-state-ledger-query-duplicated
body: `has_pending_state` and `db_has_pending_state` each inline `pending_removals`' ledger query (`MATCH (n:PendingRemoval) RETURN n.fqn ORDER BY n.fqn`) to keep the read on one connection of their own handle, so the query string now lives in three places in this file (`pending_removals`, `has_pending_state`, `db_has_pending_state`). Upgrade to a connection-taking ledger reader shared by all three when a caller must reuse a connection and a fourth copy would otherwise appear.
